title: VERA: Verifiable Feasibility Representations with Counterfactual Credit for Constrained Multi-Agent Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.38889v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Constrained multi-agent control requires more than predicting rewarding actions: an action can cease to be executable as contact windows, shared capacity, and deadlines change. We introduce VERA, a centralized-training, decentralized-execution framework that separates feasibility estimation from credit assignment. Each actor predicts a five-dimensional verifiable feasibility representation (VFR). After an action is proposed, exact action-conditioned margins available only during training supervise that representation, while a counterfactual group-relative advantage (CGRA) ranks candidate representation-action pairs. Execution uses one actor pass and no privileged state. In a dynamic space-air-ground integrated network (SAGIN), VERA obtains 55.33% +/- 3.60% success with 0.45% +/- 0.81% coverage violation, within 1.33 percentage points of a privileged-mask reference. translated_title: VERA：面向受限多智能体控制的具有反事实信用分配的可验证可行性表示
translated_abstract: 受限多智能体控制所需的不仅仅是预测能带来奖励的动作：随着接触窗口、共享容量和截止期限的变化，一个动作可能不再可执行。我们提出了VERA，这是一个集中训练、分散执行的框架，将可行性估计与信用分配分离开来。每个执行者（actor）预测一个五维的可验证可行性表示（VFR）。在提出动作之后，仅在训练阶段可用的精确动作条件裕度（margins）对该表示进行监督，同时反事实组相对优势（CGRA）对候选的表示-动作对进行排序。执行阶段仅需一次actor前向传播，且不使用任何特权状态。在动态空天地一体化网络（SAGIN）中，VERA获得了55.33% ± 3.60%的成功率和0.45% ± 0.81%的覆盖违反率，与特权掩码参考基线的差距在1.33个百分点以内。在十组配对种子上奖励匹配的条件下，VERA将成功率提升了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: VERA提出了一种集中训练、分散执行的受限多智能体控制框架，通过五维可验证可行性表示与反事实组相对优势将可行性估计和信用分配分离，在动态空天地一体化网络中仅靠单次推理且无特权状态即可达到接近特权掩码基线的性能。
en_tdlr: VERA is a centralized-training, decentralized-execution framework for constrained multi-agent control that decouples feasibility estimation from credit assignment via five-dimensional verifiable feasibility representations and counterfactual group-relative advantages, achieving near-privileged performance in dynamic SAGIN with a single actor pass and no privileged state.
